visual_synopsis: Shot in a desaturated near-black-and-white gangster-film style, a black SUV drives through a bare village and pulls up at a yard piled with building stone, and two heavies in black get out and go into a poor house. Inside a dim kitchen they confront a blonde middle-aged woman, a man in a knit beanie and a blond mustached man in a blazer, and the rest of the sketch is tense close-up talking and pleading between them.
